Hints: Find x such that 35x leaves remainder 1 when divided by 64.
Solution: Back-substitution gives 35*(11) + 64*(-6) = 1. Reduce 11 modulo 64 to get 11; 35*11 = 64*6 + 1.

Question Choices: Find the least nonnegative remainder of 9^27 modulo 28.
Hints: Square and reduce after every step; combine powers according to the binary expansion of the exponent.
Solution: Repeated squaring modulo 28 gives 9^1 ≡ 9; 9^2 ≡ 25; 9^4 ≡ 9; 9^8 ≡ 25; 9^16 ≡ 9. Since 27 = 1 + 2 + 8 + 16, multiply the corresponding residues 9 * 25 * 25 * 9 and reduce modulo 28 to obtain 1.
